meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1001 (data provider DP2), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Amounts in ₹ crore; counts as numbers; ratios in per cent, as each row's label says. 891 cells the source prints more than once with different values (2024-03-31) are left out: we cannot tell which value is right.
